dataset: Delhi Multi-Site Air-Quality Data Set V1 prepared hourly table
source: Sonawani, Shilpa; Patil, Kailas (2021), Mendeley Data
notes: The gzip file decompresses to the prepared CSV bytes provided in the Main ZIP.
The prepared CSV digest does not match the digest in the Main ZIP model manifest; those model artifacts are excluded.
No station coordinates are bundled or assumed. This dataset is separate from the ITO 2024-2026 experiment.
